taskspec.goal: Make certification evidence fully restart-reconstructible after process or machine loss. The 2026-08-16 real crash exposed three evidence-persistence gaps (packet bytes, terminal dispatch HEAD evidence, baseline failure identities) plus one observation-durability gap.
taskspec.title: Crash-resilient certification evidence
verification_steps: ONE final broad hermetic regression for the coherent package
persist passing/failing/skipped counts AND exact failing node IDs

justification: Cross-cutting Engineer Worker certification infrastructure explicitly authorized by the operator after the 2026-08-16 real machine crash. cited_reason: No specific information about test results directly corresponding to some criteria.
distinction_from_rerolling: The prior 0C session recorded that rewording a packet until the reviewer agrees is rerolling in substance. That case differed: there the reviewer cited five tests as FAILING when all five passed, so its stated reasons were false and no change to the evidence was warranted. Here the stated reason is TRUE of the artifact -- the outcomes were genuinely absent -- so supplying them repairs a real deficiency rather than restating the same claim more persuasively.
genuine_evidence_deficiency: TEST_RESULT and TEST_COUNT artifacts were attached to the packet but never BOUND to any criterion, and each criterion required only SOURCE and TEST_SOURCE. Completeness therefore passed while the reviewer received test SOURCE and no per-criterion test OUTCOMES. This is the INSUFFICIENT_ALONE failure mode this repository already names.
material_change: each criterion now requires TEST_RESULT and is bound to captured pytest -v runner output for the tests that actually prove it

observations: Identity comparison caught a defect in its own certification run. An earlier baseline captured CONCURRENTLY with the candidate reported 16 failures and named one as fixed by this branch -- impossible for a diff touching no GUI code. Under the count-only scheme it would have read as an improvement. Regression captures must be serialised.

Certification evidence was briefly written to /tmp, which WSL cleaned mid-session, destroying both captures and a worktree. The durability lesson of this mission reproduced in miniature by its own implementer.
The completeness gate refused a packet that bound an artifact which was present but EMPTY, before any reviewer call. Bound-but-empty is the shape a hand-assembled packet most easily takes.
bind_candidate refused the first deterministic PASS because it carried no verified_files. A PASS naming no content cannot be tied to a commit; it was re-recorded with digests rather than re-pointed.

The reviewer ABSTAINed on a packet whose TEST_RESULT artifacts were attached but never BOUND to a criterion. Its reason was factually true, which is what distinguished a legitimate one-time repair from rerolling.

corrects: the ew0a-cr-t1 completion report, which is preserved unedited
error: The completion report listed CANDIDATE_SHA = 14793ca alongside GPT_VERDICT = PASS. The semantic review was in fact dispatched against 8ddedb9, and 14793ca is the commit that recorded that review as evidence. Two distinct identities were reported as one, so the report implied the PASS covered the PR head when it did not.
repair: Formalize reviewed_candidate_sha and certification_head_sha as separate identities, and bridge them with a deterministic CertificationTailProof rather than another semantic review.
verdict_scope: The PASS on pkt_db56c5a51792e409ff94ca8bff771883 remains valid historical semantic evidence for 8ddedb9. It does NOT certify 14793ca, and is not withdrawn, relabelled or rerolled.
why_it_happened: A git-tracked review artifact embeds the candidate SHA it describes, so it cannot be part of that same commit. The certification evidence necessarily lands in a DESCENDANT of the commit it certifies. Nothing in the model named that descendant, so the reporting step silently used git HEAD.

consequence: CRASH_RECONSTRUCTIBLE_CERTIFICATION = YES was claimed at the component level and reported without qualifying that the autonomous worker path was not forced through it.
explanation: The crash-resilience machinery was proven by component tests and used for this task's own review, but the mandatory EW-0A certification path is ew0a_loop.run_task -> ew0a.certify_attempt -> ew0a.build_supervisor_packet -> supervisor(packet), which consults the independent supervisor with an ephemeral dict and persists nothing. The autonomous operating loop could therefore still reach VERIFIED without exact packet persistence, reload and hash verification, journal write-ahead state, terminal HEAD evidence or duplicate-review protection.
repair: make durable certification the only route to VERIFIED
